title: #49 Company Workers
prompt: In the company, some people think the employers should involve the workers in decision making. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages.

promptSegments.text: In the company, some people think the employers should involve the workers in decision making.

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.
Đưa ra nhận định tổng thể theo yêu cầu.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Involving workers in decisions makes the work environment better because staff feel more valued and work together more happily.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Involving workers in decisions makes the work environment better because staff feel more valued and work together more happily.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Worker ideas help the company run smoothly because staff who do the work every day know the problems best.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Involving staff in planning makes them feel more connected and proud of the work, leading them to work harder and generate better ideas.

angles.label: Point 2
